stepBody: See image. Use sample $$_{}$$ proportions. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure4.gif##

figureAlts.figure4.gif: (b) Write a function called one_race that simulates a single race of 100 time steps. It should return a two-element array of the final distances of both the tortoise and the hare (in that order) from the origin after 100 time steps. A fill-in-the-blank code block defining the function one_race. Inside the function: tortoise_array is assigned Blank 1, hare_array is assigned Blank 2, tortoise_sim is assigned Blank 3, hare_sim is assigned Blank 4, tortoise_distance is assigned Blank 5, hare_distance is assigned Blank 6. The function returns make_array with tortoise_distance and hare_distance as arguments.
